verdict.rationale: dlt offers a curated catalog of "verified sources" that the docs describe as "developed and maintained by the dlt team and community." The "verified" label is a coarse signal of vetting and ownership. Nothing shows per-connector maturity, support-level, or maintainer labels in the catalog. Missing for 10: per-connector maturity/stability labels, explicit support-level tiers, per-connector maintainer attribution, independent corroboration.
